name: Darkweave Spinner
description: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

abilities.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

abilities.name: Shadow Fang
abilities.description: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.
